purpose: Teach: 環境庁/窒素/憲章/圧勝/疑念/塩素/至福/皇族

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、環境庁時代の規制研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered regulatory research from your time at the Environment Ministry in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, confirming tone. Steady pace. A teacher checking in with genuine curiosity about the student's work, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、窒素酸化物の削減策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about nitrogen oxide reduction strategies.
lines.style: Respectful, clear response. Direct eye contact level. Slight formality appropriate to speaking with a teacher about academic work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国連憲章の改正案を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered proposed amendments to the UN Charter in your paper, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured tone. Slight pause before the question, as if recalling details. Genuine interest, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、選挙での圧勝事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined landslide electoral victories as a case study.
lines.style: Composed, direct. Maintaining the respectful register. A student confident in her research but not overstepping.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家への疑念の構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also explored the structure of political skepticism in your paper, I see?
lines.style: Engaged but not pressing. Warm recognition. A teacher confirming she's been following the student's intellectual arc.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、プールの塩素濃度管理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper focused on chlorine concentration management in swimming pools.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. No apology for the pivot. A student stating her work clearly and directly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 登山家の至福体験を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the transcendent experiences of mountaineers — that was another focus of yours?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry. Slower pace. A teacher reflecting on the breadth of the student's research interests with quiet appreciation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、英王室皇族の役割を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I investigated the roles and responsibilities of the British royal family.
lines.style: Final, clear statement. Confident without being defiant. A student concluding her account of her work with composure and finality.
